t0300-01.gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
t0300-01.rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

t0300-02.gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
t0300-02.rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
